manifest.name: chromium-bidi

scripts.test: npm run unit && npm run e2e
scripts.format: npm run format:eslint && npm run format:prettier && npm run format:py && npm run format:keep-sorted
scripts.rdb-e2e: rdb stream -new -realm chromium:public -- npm run e2e
scripts.rdb-unit: rdb stream -new -realm chromium:public -- npm run unit
scripts.format:py: (command -v ruff_chromium >/dev/null && ruff_chromium check --fix . && ruff_chromium format .) || (PATH="../../third_party/depot_tools:$PATH" ruff_chromium check --fix . && PATH="../../third_party/depot_tools:$PATH" ruff_chromium format .)

manifest.description: An implementation of the WebDriver BiDi protocol for Chromium implemented as a JavaScript layer translating between BiDi and CDP, running inside a Chrome tab.
